item.content:encoded:
Goal

Long-term asset value growth exceeding the increase in Bitcoin’s valuation against the US dollar.

Investment approach 

Asset management is carried out using fully automated quantitative long/short algorithmic investment strategies. The potential to achieve targeted returns has been verified against all available historical data sets. The resilience of the investment approach used has been confirmed by walk-forward analysis with the application of the Monte Carlo method. The portfolio consists of the most liquid market instruments.
